title: Can You Fool A Self Driving Car?
summary: Mark Rober tests whether self-driving cars can be fooled, comparing a lidar-equipped car with a camera-only Tesla in scenarios including a painted Wile E. Coyote wall and smoke.
why: HN uses it as the reference demonstration in lidar versus camera debates, though some critics fault its methodology and style.

quote.text: LiDAR passed all of them, while Tesla’s camera-only approach failed half.
